**Texas's 34th congressional district** is a United States congressional district in the southern part of Texas that was created as a result of the [2010 census](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2010_United_States_census "2010 United States census").[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas's_34th_congressional_district#cite_note-4) The first candidates ran in the [2012 elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2012_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections "2012 United States House of Representatives elections"); the winner, [Democrat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Democratic_Party_(United_States) "Democratic Party (United States)")[Filemon Vela Jr.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Filemon_Vela_Jr. "Filemon Vela Jr."), was seated for the [113th United States Congress](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/113th_United_States_Congress "113th United States Congress").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas's_34th_congressional_district#cite_note-5) The district is currently represented by [Vicente Gonzalez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vicente_Gonzalez_(American_politician) "Vicente Gonzalez (American politician)") ([D](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Democratic_Party_(United_States) "Democratic Party (United States)")-[McAllen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McAllen,_Texas "McAllen, Texas")), who was redistricted there from [Texas's 15th congressional district](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas's_15th_congressional_district "Texas's 15th congressional district").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas's_34th_congressional_district#cite_note-6)

Texas's 34th congressional district is composed of the area on the Gulf Coast between [Brownsville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brownsville,_Texas "Brownsville, Texas") and [Corpus Christi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corpus_Christi,_Texas "Corpus Christi, Texas"), the latter of which being situated in the neighboring [27th congressional district](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas's_27th_congressional_district "Texas's 27th congressional district").[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas's_34th_congressional_district#cite_note-7) It extends westward to include the northeastern portion of [McAllen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McAllen,_Texas "McAllen, Texas") and surrounds, with the rest of the [McAllen area](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hidalgo_County,_Texas "Hidalgo County, Texas") being in the [15th](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas's_15th_congressional_district "Texas's 15th congressional district"). In addition to the City of Brownsville, other major towns in the district include [Alice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alice,_Texas "Alice, Texas"), [Beeville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beeville,_Texas "Beeville, Texas"), [Harlingen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harlingen,_Texas "Harlingen, Texas"), [Kingsville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kingsville,_Texas "Kingsville, Texas") and [San Benito](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Benito,_Texas "San Benito, Texas").

The district was one of 13 congressional districts that voted for [Donald Trump](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Trump "Donald Trump") in the [2024 presidential election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_United_States_presidential_election "2024 United States presidential election") while simultaneously electing a Democrat in the [2024 House of Representatives elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections "2024 United States House of Representatives elections").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texas's_34th_congressional_district#cite_note-8)
